headline: Pool Corporation Announces Upcoming Investor Conference Participation
summary: COVINGTON, La., Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pool Corporation (Nasdaq: POOL) announced today that it will participate in the following investor events in the third quarter of 2026: August 11, 2026 – Deutsche Bank’s Chicago Industrials SummitSeptember 10, 2026 – Jefferies Global Industrials ConferenceSeptember 15, 2026 – Goldman Sachs Global Consumer and Retail Conference Investor-related materials and company information are available on the Investor Relations section of POOLCORP’s website.
